summary: Ennis, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 20, 2026, to report its financial results for the quarter and fiscal year ended February 28, 2026, and to announce the date of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders. The filing includes a press release detailing revenues of $96.4 million for the quarter and $392.4 million for the fiscal year, along with earnings per share and gross profit margins. There are no transactions or special situation events described, making this a routine earnings and meeting notice filing.
